annotations.title: Import duty and VAT for a cross-border purchase

description: Work out the REAL cost of buying an item in one country and having it shipped to another: import duty, VAT or GST, and the final total. Figures are read from official tariff texts, not estimated. Returns `calcolabile: false` — with no numbers and a reason — for destinations whose rules are not modelled; never substitute a guess. Country codes are two-letter ISO (IT, US, JP, GB...). Call `elenco_categorie` if unsure which category to pass.

paese_arrivo.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. IT, US, JP, GB.

paese_partenza.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. IT, US, JP, GB.

prezzo.description: Price of the goods, excluding shipping.

prodotto.description: What the shopper is buying, in their own words. Always pass it when known: the answer then carries `confronta_su_crossave`, the live comparison of every store selling that item with duty and shipping in the total.

venduto_su_marketplace.description: True if bought through a marketplace (eBay, Amazon...): under EU rules it often collects VAT at checkout, and it must not be charged twice.

name: calcola_costo_totale
